claims.text: Nguyên văn (Friedländer): In the same manner you will come nearer to the knowledge and comprehension of God by the negative attributes.

sources.quote: In the same manner you will come nearer to the knowledge and comprehension of God by the negative attributes

claims.text: Nguyên văn: ... you have undoubtedly come one step nearer to the knowledge of God.
